description: This file defines the BuzzFeedPost class within the OrangeHRM system, representing a data transfer object (DTO) for a social media buzz post, including its properties, constructor, and getter methods for post details such as ID, text, type, stats, creation date, and media links.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPost
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a feed post in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, encapsulating post details, media, and metadata, with methods to access various post attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this share.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the post or share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type of the post: video, photo, or text.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Provides statistics including number of likes, comments, and shares.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the post/share in Y-m-d format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the post/share in H:i format.

methods.name: getOriginalPost
methods.description: Returns details of the original post if this share is a share, null if not.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns information about the employee who made the share or post.

methods.name: isLiked
methods.description: Returns whether the current user liked this post.

methods.name: getVideoLink
methods.description: Returns the URL link to the video if the post contains a video.

methods.name: getPhotoIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of photos associated with the post, if any.

methods.name: hasPhotos
methods.description: Checks if the post has associated photos.

methods.name: hasVideo
methods.description: Checks if the post contains a video link.

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description: Returns permissions related to updating or deleting the post.
